The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED` on the visible testbench).

Two spec violations were found and fixed in `rtl/uart_tx.v`:

1. **Reset value of `tx`**: it was reset to `1'b0` (line idle) instead of `1'b1`, violating "while `rst_n` is low, `tx = 1`".
2. **`tx_data`/`tx_start` not ignored while busy**: `data_r` was captured on *any* edge where `tx_start` was high, even mid-frame, so a `tx_start` asserted during an active transmission would corrupt the byte being sent. Fixed to only capture when accepted (`state == S_IDLE && tx_start`).

I verified both fixes with a throwaway testbench covering idle `tx` after reset and a `tx_start` held during an active frame (confirmed it no longer corrupts the in-flight byte), then removed that scratch file—only the official `tb/tb_visible.v` test and the `rtl/uart_tx.v` fix remain.
